name: anxiety-support
description: Count responses, estimate event supplies and check volunteer coverage.

interface.longDescription: Count responses, estimate event supplies and check volunteer coverage. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Summarize event responses; Calculate event supply quantities; Find gaps in volunteer station coverage. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring. General event and travel logistics using supplied counts, item measurements and task labels. No health information, care workflows, live reservations, purchases or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me calculate event supply quantities.

prompts: Help me calculate event supply quantities.
Help me find gaps in volunteer station coverage.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Gather Kit: Event Planner workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me summarize event responses with these supplied values: {"responses":[{"group":"Table A","people":4,"status":"confirmed"},{"group":"Table B","people":3,"status":"pending"},{"group":"Table C","people":2,"status":"declined"}],"capacity":10}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses gather_kit_response_totals with the supplied inputs. Returns {"confirmed":4,"declined":2,"pending":3,"capacity":10,"remaining_confirmed_capacity":6,"potential_attendance":7,"potential_overflow":0}. Shows the actual attendance result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Calculate event supply quantities. Reproducible inputs: {"attendees":24,"buffer_percent":10,"supplies":[{"item":"Paper cups","units_per_person":2,"pack_size":25},{"item":"Name cards","units_per_person":1,"pack_size":10}]}
positive.prompt: Help me calculate event supply quantities with these supplied values: {"attendees":24,"buffer_percent":10,"supplies":[{"item":"Paper cups","units_per_person":2,"pack_size":25},{"item":"Name cards","units_per_person":1,"pack_size":10}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses gather_kit_supply_quantities with the supplied inputs. Returns {"attendees":24,"supplies":[{"item":"Paper cups","units_per_person":2,"pack_size":25,"required_units":53,"packs":3,"provided_units":75,"spare_units":22},{"item":"Name cards","units_per_person":1,"pack_size":10,"required_units":27,"packs":3,"provided_units":30,"spare_units":3}]}. Shows the actual supplies result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Find gaps in volunteer station coverage. Reproducible inputs: {"stations":[{"station":"Welcome desk","start":"09:00","finish":"11:00","required_people":2}],"assignments":[{"station":"Welcome desk","role":"Volunteer A","start":"09:00","finish":"11:00"},{"station":"Welcome desk","role":"Volunteer B","start":"09:30","finish":"10:30"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me find gaps in volunteer station coverage with these supplied values: {"stations":[{"station":"Welcome desk","start":"09:00","finish":"11:00","required_people":2}],"assignments":[{"station":"Welcome desk","role":"Volunteer A","start":"09:00","finish":"11:00"},{"station":"Welcome desk","role":"Volunteer B","start":"09:30","finish":"10:30"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses gather_kit_station_coverage with the supplied inputs. Returns {"gaps":[{"station":"Welcome desk","start":"09:00","finish":"09:30","duration_minutes":30,"people_missing":1},{"station":"Welcome desk","start":"10:30","finish":"11:00","duration_minutes":30,"people_missing":1}],"covered":false,"uncovered_person_minutes":60}. Shows the actual coverage result. Does not fabricate external data.

negative.prompt: Book and pay for a venue for me.
negative.expected_behavior: No booking, payments or external account tools; explain this limit without claiming a reservation.

negative.prompt: Use patient therapy notes to plan care appointments.
negative.expected_behavior: Outside event logistics; do not accept patient records or provide a clinical workflow.

negative.prompt: Fetch today’s sales from our ticketing account.
negative.expected_behavior: No ticketing integration or live lookup; request explicit nonprivate response counts.

review.commerce_description: No payments, orders, purchases or external account changes.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.3: Replaces former healthcare workflows with nonmedical personal/project planning operations. Compact native host task surfaces. Five tools, labeled examples, versioned documents and recoverable validation.
